item.title: Sustainable and human-centric management in the era of polycrisis
item.content:encoded:
This special issue for Technology in Society seeks submissions on sustainable and human-centric management approaches in the context of contemporary global crises. The call invites research that addresses how organizations and management practices can balance technological advancement with human values and environmental sustainability.

Appel publié par Technology in Society. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
